sanskrit: manasā saṃkalpayati tad devām̐ api gacchati | atho ha brahmāṇo vaśām upaprayanti yācitum ||
english: She resolves it in her mind, and that resolve reaches even the gods; and so the Brahmins approach the vaśā cow, drawing near to beg for her.

sanskrit: svadhākāreṇa pitṛbhyo yajñena devatābhyaḥ | dānena rājanyo vaśāyā mātur heḍaṃ na gacchati ||
english: By the svadhā offering to the ancestors, by sacrifice to the gods, by the gift of the vaśā cow — the prince does not incur the wrath of his mother.

sanskrit: vaśā rājanya te mātā tathā saṃbhūtam agraśaḥ | tasyā āhur anarpaṇaṃ ya brahmabhyaḥ pradīyate ||
english: O prince, the vaśā cow is your mother — so it has come to be from the beginning. They declare that not giving her who is to be presented to the Brahmins is non-surrender of what is owed.

sanskrit: yathājyaṃ pratigṛhītam ālumpet sruco agnaye | evā ha brahmāṇo vaśām āgnaye vṛścate 'dadhat ||
english: Just as the clarified butter received in the ladle would flow into the fire for the god, so indeed the Brahmins, if one does not give the vaśā cow, cut him off for the fire.

sanskrit: puroḍāśavatsā sudughā loke asyopa tiṣṭhati | sāsmai sarvān kāmān duhe vaśā pradaduṣe bahūn ||
english: With the sacrificial cake as her calf, easily milked, she stands available for him in this world; for the one who has given her, the vaśā cow milks all desires in abundance.

sanskrit: sarvān kāmān yamarājye vaśā pradaduṣe duhe | athāhur nārakaṃ lokaṃ nirundhānasya yācitām ||
english: In the realm of Yama too the vaśā cow milks all desires for the one who has given her; but they declare a hellish world for him who withholds her when she has been begged for.

sanskrit: pravīyamānā carati kruddhā gopataye vaśā | vehataṃ mā manyamāno mṛtyoḥ pāśeṣu badhyatām ||
english: The vaśā cow wanders about in distress, angry with her keeper; let him who regards her as barren be bound in the nooses of Death.

sanskrit: yo vehataṃ manyamāno gṛheṣu pacate vaśām | apy asya putrān pautrāṃś ca yācayate bṛhaspatiḥ ||
english: He who regards her as a barren animal and cooks the vaśā cow in his house — Bṛhaspati will make even his sons and grandsons become beggars.

sanskrit: mahad eṣā vi tapati carantī goṣu gaur api | tato ha gopataye vaśā daduṣe viṣaṃ duhe ||
english: Greatly does she blaze with wrath, roaming among the cattle, the cow; and so the vaśā cow milks poison for the keeper who has given her away in that manner.

sanskrit: priyaṃ paśūnāṃ bhavati yad brahmabhyaḥ pradīyate | ato vaśāyās tat priyaṃ yad devatrā haviḥ syāt ||
english: Whatever is given to Brahmins becomes dear to the livestock; therefore that is dear about the vaśā cow: that she should become an oblation offered to the gods.

sanskrit: yā vaśā udakalpayan devā yajñād udetya | tāsāṃ viliptyaṃ bhīmām udākuruta nāradaḥ ||
english: The vaśā cows that the gods set apart upon arising from the sacrifice — among them Nārada singled out the fearsome viliptyā cow.

sanskrit: tāṃ devā amīmāṃsanta vaśeyāṃ na vaśeti | tām abravīn nārada eṣā vaśānāṃ vaśatamā ||
english: The gods deliberated about her: is she a vaśā or not a vaśā? Nārada said to them: she is the most thoroughly vaśā among all vaśā cows.

sanskrit: kati nu vaśā nārada yās tvaṃ vettha manuṣyajāḥ | katamāsāṃ bhīmatamā kasyā nāśnīyād abrāhmaṇaḥ ||
english: How many vaśā cows born among men do you know, O Nārada? Which of them is the most fearsome? Whose flesh should a non-Brahmin not eat?

sanskrit: viliptyā bṛhaspate yā ca sūtavaśā vaśā | tāsāṃ nāśnīyād abrāhmaṇo ya āśaṃseti bhūtyām ||
english: The viliptyā cow, O Bṛhaspati, and also the sūtavaśā cow — of these, a non-Brahmin who desires prosperity should not eat.

sanskrit: namas te astu nārada- -anuṣṭha viduṣe vaśā | katamāsāṃ bhīmatamā yām adattvā parābhavet ||
english: Homage be to you, O Nārada — instruct us concerning the vaśā for the knowing one. Which is the most fearsome of them, by not giving which one would come to ruin?

sanskrit: viliptyā bṛhaspate yā ca sūtavaśā vaśā | yāḥ prayacched brahmabhyo ya āśaṃśeti bhūtyām ||
english: The viliptyā, O Bṛhaspati, and the sūtavaśā cow — these one should give to the Brahmins, he who desires prosperity.

sanskrit: trīṇi vai vaśājātāni viliptī sūtavaśā vaśā | tāḥ pra yacched brahmabhyaḥ syonāvaskaḥ prajāpatau ||
english: There are truly three kinds of vaśā: viliptyā, sūtavaśā, and vaśā. One should give these to Brahmins, resting at ease under the care of Prajāpati.

sanskrit: etad vo brāhmaṇā havir iti manvīta yācitaḥ | vaśāṃ ced enaṃ yāceyur yā bhīmādaduṣo gṛhe ||
english: He who is asked should think: "This is an oblation for you, O Brahmins" — if the Brahmins should beg the vaśā from him which the fearsome one gave in his house.

sanskrit: devā vaśām upāvadan na no dād iti hīḍitāḥ | etābhir ṛgbhir bhedasya tasmād vai sa parābhavat ||
english: The gods, angered, whispered about the vaśā cow: "He will not give her to us." By these very hymns of Bheda, therefore that man came to ruin.

sanskrit: utaitāṃ bhedo nāradād vaśām indreṇa yācitaḥ | tasmāt taṃ devā enaso vṛścann ahamuttare ||
english: And Bheda, when asked by Indra, took this vaśā cow away from Nārada; therefore the gods cut him off from well-being, saying "We are the superior ones.".

sanskrit: ye vaśāyā adānāya vadanti parirāpinaḥ | indrasya manyave jālmā ā vṛścante acityā ||
english: Those scoundrels who speak in favor of not giving the vaśā cow — the wretches, through their unwisdom, cut themselves off from Indra's favor.

sanskrit: yo gopatiṃ pārāṇīya- -athāhur mā dadā iti | rudrasyās tāṃ hetiṃ te pari yanty acetasaḥ ||
english: He who, having brought the keeper of cattle to the other side, then says "Do not give" — those mindless ones circle around that weapon of Rudra.

sanskrit: yadi hutāṃ yady ahutām amā ca pacate vaśām | devān sabrāhmaṇān ṛtvā jihmo lokān nir ṛcchati ||
english: Whether she has been offered or not offered in sacrifice, if one cooks the vaśā cow at home — having struck down both gods and Brahmins, the crooked one proceeds to the lower worlds.

sanskrit: asṛṅ māṃsaṃ tvacaṃ peṣṭraṃ mastṛhaṇaṃ majjñaḥ śarīram | agniḥ kravyād attv amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya ||
english: Blood, flesh, skin, the crushed parts, the brain, the marrow, the body — let the flesh-eating fire devour all of these of so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman.

sanskrit: prātaryāvadbhyo devebhyaḥ sāyaṃyāvadbhyo devebhyo viśvadānīṃyāvadbhyo devebhyaḥ | amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi ||
english: To the gods who are present at morning, to the gods who are present at evening, to the gods who are present at all times — I cut off so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman.

sanskrit: vaiśvānarāya kṣipradhanvane 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi ||
english: To Vaiśvānara, the swift-bowman — I cut off this so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman.

sanskrit: kṣipradhanvan kṣiprahasta | amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya hṛdayaṃ yakṛn matasne pra vidhya ||
english: O swift-bowman, swift-handed one — pierce the heart, the liver, and the two kidneys of so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman.

sanskrit: indrāgnibhyāṃ prajāpataye parameṣṭhine somāya rājñe varuṇāya rājñe | pūṣṇe dhātre savitre tvaṣṭre 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi ||
english: To Indra and Agni, to Prajāpati, to Parameṣṭhin, to King Soma, to King Varuṇa, to Pūṣan, to Dhātṛ, to Savitṛ, to Tvaṣṭṛ — I cut off this so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman.

sanskrit: uṣase 'hne rātraye sūryāyāmum (…) ||
english: To Dawn, to Day, to Night, to the Sun — I cut off this [so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman].

sanskrit: vīrudbhya oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo vānaspatebhyo 'mum (…) ||
english: To the creeping plants, to the herbs, to the lord-of-the-forest trees, to the forest-born plants — I cut off this [so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman].

sanskrit: adbhyo mātariśvane 'dyāvāpṛthivībhyām amum (…) ||
english: To the waters, to Mātariśvan, to Heaven-and-Earth together — I cut off this [so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman].

sanskrit: idāvatsarāya parivatsarāya saṃvatsarāya bṛhate viśvarūpāyāmum (…) ||
english: To the idā-year, to the pari-year, to the saṃ-year, to the great all-formed [year] — I cut off this [so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman].

sanskrit: mādbhyaḥ saṃvatsarāyāmum (…) ||
english: To the months, to the year — I cut off this [so-and-so, son of so-and-so, born of such-and-such a woman].
